messages:
Aisha: Quick check-in on Aurora — weekly tail perf snapshot. p95/p99 by route/model, streaming vs non-streaming. Noticing some regressions on /chat. Posting numbers below.

Marco: Thanks, dropping numbers I pulled from telemetry for last 7d:
```
Route    | Model                  | Mode        | p95(ms) | p99(ms)
/chat    | redwood-instruct-4k    | streaming   | 340     | 720
/chat    | redwood-instruct-4k    | non-stream  | 260     | 430
/generate| mosaic-7b              | streaming   | 220     | 360
/generate| mosaic-7b              | non-stream  | 210     | 330
/emb     | rwkv-13b               | streaming   | 95      | 130
/emb     | rwkv-13b               | non-stream  | 90      | 120
```
Aisha: Hmm streaming /chat p99 +290ms vs non-stream — cost of muxing? :thinking:
Devon: I can see increased tail on the worker logs, maybe KV cache misses during stream handoff.
Ella: Any correlation with batch size or sequence length? Aurora's average seq_len spiked to 900 on last week.
Marco: Yes, 900 median for /chat. Also 2% increase in 5xxs on streaming routes.
Aisha: Renewal flag: low. Aurora is in onboarding month 2; they're close to commit but concerned about tail. We should keep close.
Devon: I'll open infra ticket and attach sample logs. Ticket: CS-3421
Ella: Can we try forcing non-stream for 10% of traffic as a canary? A/B rollback if latency improves.
Aisha: Good — can we get an estimated impact on p99 if we shift 10% to non-stream?
Marco: Quick sim using recent qps: shifts p99 for /chat -> from 720 to ~690ms (small), but if we shift 30% then ~640ms.
Devon: Root cause hypothesis: streaming handshake + small initial token overhead + cache cold starts on model shards. I'll run a kv-hit-rate query: `SELECT kv_hit_rate FROM telemetry WHERE customer=\'aurora\' AND week=now()-7d`
opsbot: deploy-canary created: aurora-nonstream-canary-2026-04-02
Aisha: Next steps:
- Devon: investigate KV caches + attach logs (CS-3421)
- Marco: run canary and monitor p95/p99 and error rate (opsbot will report)
- Ella: prep a customer note summarizing expected improvements and timeline
Aisha: Thanks team :raised_hands:
Marco: noted, will post canary link and initial metrics in this thread
Devon: attaching preliminary logs in ticket now
Ella: I'll draft the note and ping @Aisha for sign-off by EOD tomorrow
